add.name: owasp-top-10-testing
add.purpose: Runs Strix's autonomous agents against an app category by category for the OWASP Top 10:2025, attempting real exploits and reporting confirmed findings.
add.how_to_use: Use when asked to test a web app against OWASP Top 10; requires the Strix CLI/agent and an LLM key; only test targets you own or are authorised to test.
add.evidence: usestrix/strix 66k stars; skills.sh ~8k installs; skillsmp top pentest results

add.name: api-security-testing
add.purpose: Security-tests REST, GraphQL or gRPC APIs with Strix: enumerates endpoints from OpenAPI/GraphQL schemas or by crawling, then exploits OWASP API Top 10 vulnerability classes.
add.how_to_use: Use for API pentests (BOLA, auth flaws, mass assignment, etc.); requires Strix and authorisation for the target.

add.name: solidity-security
add.purpose: Smart-contract security patterns and vulnerability checklist (reentrancy, access control, oracle manipulation, etc.) for writing and auditing Solidity.
add.how_to_use: Triggers when writing or auditing Solidity/EVM contracts.
add.evidence: wshobson/agents 40k stars; skills.sh ~14.8k installs (top 'security' result not yet listed)
add.notes: Only smart-contract entry in the security list.

checked: skills.sh search API (queries per topic, by installs); skillsmp.com API (sortBy=stars); gh api tree/contents verification; queries: security, pentest, vulnerability, threat-model, owasp, secrets, fuzzing, malware, smart-contract, trailofbits, iam; skillsmp: 'security audit', 'penetration testing'
